question:
The sequence of folding a piece of paper and the manner in which the folded paper has been cut is shown below. Choose the figure that would most closely resemble the unfolded form of the paper.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dbd9b5485560cc988eee935aa4a34057ef70ddaced948368f5071246135d739.png]
solution:
**Explanation:**

We unfold the paper step by step:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a41cefe3df47bf71e46a5e52234532abcc3f48e43b792856615e46f0718c0e9.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) The pattern is correct.

Option 2) Upper half of the pattern is incorrect.

Option 3) The pattern is not symmetrical.

Option 4) Right half of the pattern is incorrect.

**Hence the correct answer is option 1.**
